decisions.reason: The financing-structure decision does not change the independently specified operating-cost basis, scope, or assumption status.
The general requirement to disclose provisional assumptions remains valid; selecting provisional financing terms does not alter its reference or disclosure policy.
Debt/equity shares, interest rate, and tranche structure do not change the twelve-site network definition or treatment of missing site-level data.

The debt schedule will consume the financing assumptions, but its requirement to provide a debt schedule and DSCR output remains unchanged; financing terms are already owned by the source Requirement.
The provisional base-case financing terms do not change the required Case F versus Case G comparison or the PPP availability-payment mechanism.
The financing decision does not resolve or modify the model currency, price-base year, or the existing CAD-to-AUD uncertainty.
The selected financing structure does not change which revenue streams must be modeled or the requirement to model them separately.
The financing mix and tranche decision do not change the site-level capex assumption basis or site typologies.
The financing assumptions affect calculated returns but do not change the requirement to produce equity IRR or its established target range.
The financing-structure decision does not alter the required CCA classes, depreciation treatment, tax shield, or equity-return tax effects.
The provisional financing structure may affect sizing calculations, but it does not change the required DSCR and equity-IRR targets or the prohibition on a negative-return DSCR-only approach.
The financing decision does not change the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
